title: Microsoft Purview DLP: block Copilot responses to prompts containing sensitive data (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents a default policy that already detects sensitive prompts in simulation mode, contrary to the briefing's claim that administrators must create a rule and that prompts are not screened by default. Blocking still requires administrator-enabled enforcement; the roadmap facts, licensing table and documented prompt-blocking behaviour are supported.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal route leads from Data Loss Prevention and custom policy creation to the Processing prompts rule action.

Retain the note specifying the Content contains > Sensitive information types condition. The cited page supplies both the policy route and the final action.

claims.claim: Blocking prompt processing requires administrator-enabled enforcement, so the blocking control is admin-opt-in.
claims.quote: If you want to block processing of the prompt, you must change the state of the policy to enforce mode.
claims.fix: Keep defaultState as admin-opt-in for blocking, and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-default-policy. Describe the default as 'The default policy detects sensitive prompts in simulation mode; blocking requires changing the policy to enforce mode.'

claims.where: summary: administrators must create the rule
claims.claim: Administrators must create a rule to use this prompt-blocking control.
claims.quote: Microsoft created a default DLP policy called Default DLP policy - Protect sensitive M365 Copilot interactions. ... If you want to block processing of the prompt, you must change the state of the policy to enforce mode.
claims.fix: Replace 'administrators must create the rule' in the summary with 'blocking requires administrator-enabled enforcement'. A new custom rule is a documented option, not a mandatory prerequisite where Microsoft's default policy is present.

Check whether it is present in your tenant before creating another policy.' Replace the risk rationale with 'Low. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-default-policy.
